requirements.text: 3+ years of experience shipping full-stack features to production in a SaaS environment.
Strong proficiency in at least one backend language such as Go, Java, Python, or C++, and one modern frontend framework such as Vue, React, or Angular.
Experience designing APIs and building services on AWS or GCP against SQL databases.

Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including API integration, prompt and context design, or tool calling. Professional or substantial personal work is acceptable, with evidence that you have built something and learned where it breaks.
Experience with Agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph), LLM evaluation tooling
Ability to write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests based on risk, with comfort using safe rollout patterns such as feature flags and canary releases.
Demonstrated ability to take a well-scoped problem to production independently.
Active use of AI tools in your development workflow.
Strong written communication skills and a BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
Pendo is a hybrid culture. In-office 3 days per week unless designated remote.
Experience building or operating an MCP server or comparable agent tooling.
Experience shipping SDKs or instrumentation libraries that customers install into their own systems, including the versioning and overhead discipline that work requires.
Experience with analytics or observability products that turn a high volume of events into something a person can act on.
Vue or data visualization tools such as Highcharts or D3.
